primitives.name: Tackler Friction Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: The superiority of the canvas jacket over the jersey lies in the fact that it gives much less hold for the fingers of the tackler, and also that it does not keep stretching until it offers an easy grasp, as does the jersey.
primitives.assumptions: Fabric tension remains linearly elastic; tackler grip force is proportional to contact area and surface stiffness.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When k_{fabric} approaches zero, L_{stretch} increases indefinitely, enabling easy grasp.

layer2.mapping: GSI models tactile engagement as stochastic process; GSE simulates grip degradation under dynamic load.

primitives.name: Sole Grip Configuration
primitives.verbatim_quote: One of the earliest plans was to lay out these strips in various different lines across the sole, in order to pre-sent an edge no matter in what direction the foot was turned.
primitives.assumptions: Strip orientation provides uniform directional grip; traction varies inversely with slip angle.
primitives.breakdown_regime: At \theta = 0, grip is maximized; at \theta = \pi/2, grip degrades due to lateral shear.

layer2.mapping: GSE maps grip vector field to motion state transition graph; GSI infers optimal strip layout via entropy minimization.
layer2.telemetry: Foot rotation angle vs. measured traction coefficient across multiple strip layouts.
